certificates_revoked_has_reason.name: certificates_revoked_has_reason
certificates_revoked_has_reason.value: "certificates"."status" <> 'revoked' or ("certificates"."revoked_at" is not null and "certificates"."revoked_reason" is not null)

consents_subject.name: consents_subject
consents_subject.value: "consents"."user_id" is not null or "consents"."email" is not null

grading_results_scale.name: grading_results_scale
grading_results_scale.value: ("grading_results"."centering_score" is null or ("grading_results"."centering_score" between 1 and 10 and "grading_results"."centering_score" * 2 = floor("grading_results"."centering_score" * 2))) and ("grading_results"."corners_score" is null or ("grading_results"."corners_score" between 1 and 10 and "grading_results"."corners_score" * 2 = floor("grading_results"."corners_score" * 2))) and ("grading_results"."edges_score" is null or ("grading_results"."edges_score" between 1 and 10 and "grading_results"."edges_score" * 2 = floor("grading_results"."edges_score" * 2))) and ("grading_results"."surface_score" is null or ("grading_results"."surface_score" between 1 and 10 and "grading_results"."surface_score" * 2 = floor("grading_results"."surface_score" * 2))) and ("grading_results"."final_grade" is null or ("grading_results"."final_grade" between 1 and 10 and "grading_results"."final_grade" * 2 = floor("grading_results"."final_grade" * 2)))

grading_results_grade_rule.name: grading_results_grade_rule
grading_results_grade_rule.value:
(
        "grading_results"."final_grade" is null or "grading_results"."centering_score" is null or "grading_results"."corners_score" is null or "grading_results"."edges_score" is null or "grading_results"."surface_score" is null
        or (
          "grading_results"."final_grade" <= least("grading_results"."centering_score", "grading_results"."corners_score", "grading_results"."edges_score", "grading_results"."surface_score") + 0.5
          and "grading_results"."final_grade" <= ceil(("grading_results"."centering_score" + "grading_results"."corners_score" + "grading_results"."edges_score" + "grading_results"."surface_score" - 1) / 2) / 2
          and ("grading_results"."final_grade" < 10 or (
            least("grading_results"."centering_score", "grading_results"."corners_score", "grading_results"."edges_score", "grading_results"."surface_score") >= 9.5
            and ("grading_results"."centering_score" = 10)::int + ("grading_results"."corners_score" = 10)::int + ("grading_results"."edges_score" = 10)::int + ("grading_results"."surface_score" = 10)::int >= 3))
          and ("grading_results"."final_grade" < 9.5 or (
            ("grading_results"."centering_score" >= 9.5)::int + ("grading_results"."corners_score" >= 9.5)::int + ("grading_results"."edges_score" >= 9.5)::int + ("grading_results"."surface_score" >= 9.5)::int >= 3
            and least("grading_results"."centering_score", "grading_results"."corners_score", "grading_results"."edges_score", "grading_results"."surface_score") >= 9))
        )
      )

grading_results_label.name: grading_results_label
grading_results_label.value:
(
        "grading_results"."final_grade" is null or "grading_results"."grade_label" is null
        or ((("grading_results"."final_grade" = 1 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Poor 1')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 2 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Fair 2')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 3 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Good 3')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 4 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Very Good 4')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Very Good-Excellent 5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 6 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Excellent 6')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 7 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Excellent 7')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 8 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Near Mint 8')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 9 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Mint 9')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 10 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Pristine 10', 'Gem Mint 10')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 9.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Mint+ 9.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 8.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Near Mint-Mint 8.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 7.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Near Mint 7.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 6.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Excellent 6.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 5.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Very Good-Excellent 5.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 4.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Very Good 4.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 3.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Good 3.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 2.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Fair 2.5')) or ("grading_results"."final_grade" = 1.5 and "grading_results"."grade_label" in ('Poor 1.5')))
          and ("grading_results"."grade_label" <> 'Pristine 10' or ("grading_results"."centering_score" = 10 and "grading_results"."corners_score" = 10 and "grading_results"."edges_score" = 10 and "grading_results"."surface_score" = 10)))
      )

grading_results_approved_has_qa.name: grading_results_approved_has_qa
grading_results_approved_has_qa.value: "grading_results"."status" <> 'approved' or ("grading_results"."qa_approved_by" is not null and ("grading_results"."final_grade" is not null or not "grading_results"."is_authentic"))
